method: Eight behavior/scenario checks executed in Node against a single captured file snapshot. Query syntax and geometry contract checked against the primary Overpass QL documentation. This is not a live Overpass or browser integration test.

tests.title: Paid or reservable public courts retain public-access status

checks.name: Fee and booking conditions remain attached

tests.title: Unknown, conditional and permit access require the optional toggle
Explicitly nonpublic records never reappear through the optional toggle
Lifecycle exclusions override stale active tags without suppressing unrelated history
Query includes semicolon-separated sport tokens with spaces and rejects substrings
The query and parser preserve node/way/relation geometry and typed identity

checks.name: Output supplies node coordinates and way/relation centres
Repeated element removed but node/way/relation IDs remain distinct
No point is fabricated for the coordinate-less node

tests.title: Sports selection does not infer courts or turn two sports into two physical courts

checks.name: One feature with tennis and pickleball remains one record
Beach volleyball appears in the Volleyball filter

tests.title: Explicit area queries are bounded and keep latitude/longitude order

notes: The displayed coordinate point for a way or relation is a bounding-box centre and can lie outside its footprint.
Independent reviewer did not mutate app source code or issue any Overpass query.
overall_result: All eight bounded classification/query scenarios passed against the recorded source snapshot. The substantive defects found in initial review were corrected by the parent agent before this test run. Live endpoint/browser operation remains outside this receipt.

findings.title: Node-mapped features were lost by the output mode
findings.initial_evidence: Original query ended with out center tags 500; normalizer requires node lat/lon.
findings.resolution: Query now uses out body center 500, preserving node points and way/relation centres.

findings.title: Contradictory lifecycle tags could appear publicly playable
findings.initial_evidence: Active leisure/sport plus disused:leisure and access=yes was classified public.
findings.resolution: Relevant inactive lifecycle markers now exclude the feature; disused=no and unrelated former shop tags do not close an active court.

findings.title: Permit access was conflated with private access
findings.resolution: Permit-required records are optional and explicitly label eligibility as unchecked. No present public-access guarantee is inferred.

findings.title: Sport token spaces caused avoidable omissions
findings.initial_evidence: The initial pattern did not match soccer; tennis when the court sport was preceded by a space.
findings.resolution: Query tolerates spaces around semicolon-delimited sport tokens and preserves exact-token boundaries.

findings.title: Generic multi-sport tags did not establish a court sport
findings.resolution: Generic multi alone is excluded; mixed tags retain supported named court sports.

findings.title: Military-only access fell through to optional unknown access
findings.resolution: Explicit nonpublic access, including military, stays hidden even with a conditional tag and the optional access toggle.

findings.title: The output cap applies before local access filtering
findings.resolution: court-finder.js marks responses with 500 elements or service remarks incomplete and exports those flags. A smaller visible count is not treated as complete coverage.

query_scope.selection: OpenStreetMap node, way and relation features tagged leisure=pitch, sports_centre or sports_hall and at least one selected court sport.
query_scope.geographic_boundaries: User-selected 1, 2 or 5 kilometre radius; latitude within -85 to +85 degrees and longitude within -180 to +180 degrees.
query_scope.result_unit: OSM map feature, not physical court. A centre and an individual court may overlap; exact duplicate element IDs are removed, separate mapped elements are retained.
query_scope.access_model: Default yes/permissive; optional unknown/conditional/permit; explicitly nonpublic or inactive features excluded. Fee and reservation tags are retained, not equated with private access.
limits: The sport vocabulary and leisure selectors are bounded. Untagged or differently mapped facilities can be absent.
No area, entrance or parent-relation access inheritance is computed. Unknown access must remain qualified.
Opening hours, permit eligibility, current bookings and conditional rules are not evaluated as live permission to play.
Ways and relations use bounding-box centres, not entrances or surveyed court coordinates.
The 500-candidate cap can omit otherwise relevant public features; partial responses stay qualified.
World coverage is uneven; this is bounded discovery, not a worldwide census.
query_scope.cross_dataset_schema_note: The curated Venice record uses beach_volleyball while OSM uses beachvolleyball. Separate layer filtering is safe; a future combined sport vocabulary should canonicalize those values explicitly.

special_venue_rechecks.name: Memorial Park tennis and pickleball courts
special_venue_rechecks.independent_evidence: City page confirms sixteen pickleball layouts on four tennis courts, courts 2–4 first-come outside programmes/permits, paid drop-in booking via ActiveNet, paddle-stack rotation and the recorded weekly drop-in hours.
special_venue_rechecks.qualification: The record correctly separates programme fees from casual access, whose fee is not stated. This was a source review, not a reservation or physical-condition check.

special_venue_rechecks.name: The Courts at The Regent’s Park
special_venue_rechecks.independent_evidence: Royal Parks offers bookable tennis, padel, netball and outdoor table tennis. It publishes daily 07:00–21:00 operation, step-free access and accessible restrooms, and seven-day advance booking with 07:00 release.
special_venue_rechecks.qualification: The source supports the four sports and accessibility-based highlight. The separate FAQ account quota, concessions and payment details were not independently rechecked in this bounded review.

special_venue_rechecks.name: Kallang Tennis Centre
special_venue_rechecks.independent_evidence: Current facility page confirms Sport Singapore management, tennis, daily 07:00–22:00 hours, 8 Stadium Boulevard and no posted closure notice. ActiveSG’s guide identifies Kallang among publicly bookable venues.
special_venue_rechecks.qualification: The guide still carries an older address and court count. The seed already handles that conflict by using the current facility page and omitting a total count. No closure notice is a dated observation, not an availability guarantee.

verification_limits: No live Overpass request was issued by this reviewer. Parent endpoint/browser checks are separate.
No browser UI, mobile layout, accessibility audit or end-to-end export test is covered by these Node scenarios.
The receipt is tied to its SHA-256; later changes require targeted rechecks only where their behavior differs.

release_follow_up.change: Validate node/way/relation type, positive safe-integer ID, object tags and geographic coordinate bounds before constructing links.
release_follow_up.method: Replayed the eight documented scenario groups from the earlier independent receipt, then added a malformed external-response/cache record group. Node execution only; live Overpass retrieval remains unverified.

tests.title: Paid and reservable public courts retain status
Unknown conditional and permit access are optional
Sport token spaces and exact boundaries
Typed IDs and geometry remain distinct
Sports do not multiply physical records
Area queries are bounded and ordered
Malformed external identities and coordinates cannot form links
